title: incremental: Crash after deleting a function.
body:
I ran into this crash with 0.501 today on the Zulip codebase when running mypy with this version of the code https://github.com/zulip/zulip/commit/09f66b5c6dfc5c8bf5d52fb51259189ade0f336e (which deleted the below function).  

I've attached the cache state tarball in case it's helpful: [mypy.tar.gz](https://github.com/python/mypy/files/866606/mypy.tar.gz)


